messages:
maria: trying to run the eval harness locally against a freshly quantized model and getting a pretty opaque crash. halp.

maria: paste of the error:
```
RuntimeError: KV cache mismatch: expected 512, got 256
  at runner.py:423
```

ken: that sounds like a tokenization/seq-length mismatch or a quantized model that changed chunking. which quantization pipeline did you use?

maria: used the quick-quant script (quantize-latest --bits 4 --per-channel). model is a trimmed gpt-large variant we just onboarded.

liam: quick troubleshooting: try forcing `--max-seq 512` or run with `--dump-config` to see what the harness guessed for context.

sasha: also, the CLI currently silently picks seq_len from the model config and *doesn't* validate it against quant metadata. we should at least preflight that early with a clear error message.

maria: dumping config shows `max_seq: 512` in harness but the quant artifact metadata says `block_size: 256`.

ken: there you go. two approaches: (1) update the model metadata to include proper block_size / round up to 512 during quantization, or (2) have the runner auto-bump and warn. prefer explicit error for safety.

maria: in the short term is there a quick patch? ci keeps failing on onboarding tests.

ci-bot: [CI] job eval-onboard-quant #412 failed: exit code 1

sasha: simple patch idea: add a preflight check that compares `model.block_size` vs config `max_seq` and returns a human readable error: "model block size 256 < configured max_seq 512 — run quantize with --pad-block 512 or set max_seq to 256". then set exit code 2 for misconfig.

liam: +1. also make the CLI print a short remediation hint rather than a full traceback. e.g., `Detected block_size mismatch (256 vs 512). Remediation: run 'quantize-latest --pad 512' or set 'max_seq' in harness config.`

maria: that would have saved me 20 mins. can someone toss a PR? low-risk.

ken: I'll open a tiny PR: change is ~20 LOC in runner/preflight.py, add message and exit code enum. also add a unit test to cover mismatch message.

ken: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/eval-harness/pull/823

sasha: also add a small note in the quickstart: "If you see KV cache mismatch, ensure your quant block_size >= max_seq or adjust harness config." current quickstart doc doesn't mention quant block sizes.

maria: another CI issue: when the test runner hits this it shows up as flaky in the dashboard because some onboarded artifacts were quantized with different legacy tool. how should we tag these failures so SRE doesn't chase them as infra flake?

liam: set the run to annotate failures with `failure_type: model_config` in the junit/ci metadata. that way dashboard filters will collapse them into a model-onboarding bucket.

sasha: good call. I'll add that to the PR too (junit annotation and an entry in the run's metadata schema).

maria: amazing. can we also add a devex CLI flag `--preflight-only` that just runs these checks and exits 0/2 so onboarding engineers can validate without consuming GPU credits?

ken: sure. will add `--preflight-only` and `--ci-mode` to suppress interactive prompts and network downloads.

liam: note for docs: update "local quickstart" to include a troubleshooting section with the exact KV cache mismatch snippet and remediation commands.

maria: thanks team. once PR merges i'll re-run the onboarding job and confirm.

devex-bot: deploy preview for PR #823 successful — integration tests started.

ci-bot: [CI] job eval-onboard-quant #413 started on pool:dedicated-gpu-2

maria: re-run passed locally with `--preflight-only` after fixing quant metadata. will push a follow-up note in onboarding jira.

sasha: filing a tiny docs task now: DOCS-142 add KV-cache mismatch troubleshooting to eval quickstart.

ken: merged PR, releasing patch 0.9.3 with the preflight checks and better error codes.

maria: confirmed CI job #413 finished ✅. thanks y'all :pray:
